comments: Final ALLFRAME+TRIAL fit to 17 of 36 Cepheids with P>25 d. Dust, bright background and anomalous aperture corrections motivated a 0.15 mag photometric random term, producing the relatively large e_R.

Alternative Key Project fit to Saha et al. photometry. Four outliers were removed from their 25-star final set, leaving 21 Cepheids; the unweighted mean of the individual dereddened moduli was adopted.
